en.p: A point $\mathrm{A}$ is at the origin of a number line. Using one die, the following trial is performed.

box: If the number rolled is 4 or less, move point $\mathrm{A}$ by 1 in the positive direction;
if it is 5 or more, move point $\mathrm{A}$ by 1 in the negative direction.

en.p: This trial is repeated 16200 times. Let $k$ be the probability that the position of the moved point $\mathrm{A}$ is 5700 or less, obtained using the standard normal table below. Find the value of $1000\times k$. [4 points]
